choice_data_list: Hey! You sure are chipper today!
Hey! You sure are chipper today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yep! I let myself have a good day of rest yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Resting's great for muscle recovery too. It's super essential for the body!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Downtime between twenty-four and forty-eight hours increases your muscle strength. It really helps you out in your next performance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Nothing but rest isn't good either though, so you need to change up which areas you work out each—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, what am I saying? Of course you already know all this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, time to go out there and get to working out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Tough it out today so my body can feel good later!
